Pass Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Pass Logistics is a UK logistics company for logistics transport, freight and warehousing. Pass Logistics employs 39 people (+5.4% YoY, +2 people), founded in 2017. Headquartered in Harworth, Northumberland, United Kingdom.

# PASS Consulting Group

PASS Consulting Group is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. PASS Consulting is a company that provides consulting services to social media and career. They offer blogs, podcasts, and information on privacy and barrier-free practices. PASS Consulting Group employs 293 people (+12.7% YoY, +33 people) and has an annual revenue of $45M, founded in 1981. Headquartered in Aschaffenburg, Bavaria, Germany, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including Germany, Tunisia, India, France, and United States).

## About

The PASS Consulting Group, headquartered in Aschaffenburg, is a provider of software, cloud services and IT consulting. Founded in 1981, the company now employs more than 500 people at its ten German and three international locations. 

Its core competence is the digitalization of companies. The basis for this is a library of IT components, Digital Business Platform, from which PASS configures corporate applications. Individual solutions are created using modeling and generation technologies. Cross-platform technologies such as automated software migration are also used. With the resulting Software Factory, PASS is the market leader in development productivity. The vision is to provide individual software solutions at the touch of a button: Solutions@fingertips. 

Customers come from the digital economy, the financial industry, the insurance industry, the travel industry, telecommunications, public administration and sport, among others.
